unitTitle: B2 · Community debate: connect ideas without losing the thread
title: Dialogues
subtitle: B2 · Unit 10: B2 · Community debate: connect ideas without losing the thread

steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Listen for the speakers' goals and how each response changes the exchange. Read once for meaning, then cover the English and summarize each person's position.

steps.title: Three voices, three priorities
steps.body: A facilitator summarizes an invented community meeting.

examples.fr: Mina propose d'ouvrir la salle le soir.
examples.en: Facilitatrice: Mina proposes opening the room in the evening.

examples.fr: Plusieurs participants travaillent pendant la journée.
examples.en: Mina: Several participants work during the day.

examples.fr: Je comprends, mais le transport est moins fréquent tard le soir.
examples.en: Louis: I understand, but transport is less frequent late in the evening.

examples.fr: Nous pourrions tester deux soirées par mois.
examples.en: Chen: We could test two evenings per month.

examples.fr: Les trois propositions tiennent compte de l'accès, mais pas de la même manière.
examples.en: Facilitatrice: All three proposals consider access, but not in the same way.

examples.fr: D'accord. Pour le transport, il faudra en parler avec l'organisme concerné.
examples.en: Louis: Agreed. For transportation, we will need to discuss it with the relevant organization.

examples.fr: Et nous y reviendrons après le premier essai.
examples.en: Mina: And we will return to it after the first trial.

examples.fr: Je noterai les points d'accord et les questions à suivre.
examples.en: Facilitatrice: I will record the points of agreement and the questions to follow up.

steps.title: Replying to an objection
steps.body: A learner clarifies which proposal a pronoun refers to.

examples.fr: La proposition de Chen prévoit deux soirées.
examples.en: Sam: Chen's proposal includes two evenings.

examples.fr: Elle propose une ouverture chaque soir de semaine.
examples.en: Sam: She proposes opening every weekday evening.

examples.fr: Alors, quand tu dis 'y revenir', tu parles de la proposition de Chen ?
examples.en: Awa: So when you say 'return to it', do you mean Chen's proposal?

examples.fr: Oui, pour éviter toute ambiguïté, je vais répéter son nom.
examples.en: Sam: Yes, to avoid any ambiguity, I will repeat its name.
